note: Extraction reference set (#22; the three cases #23 handed over). Synthetic companies, source texts already in redacted form (no personal data). 'recorded' holds the model answers used by the fake provider (plumbing only: it says nothing about the quality of a real model); live runs ignore it. 'expected' maps each requested field to its accepted values (compared ignoring case), or to null when the sources hold no public evidence.

cases.description: A clear English page: every stated field is found with a verbatim quote; a field the page does not state is not_found.

sources.text: Brightwell Components Ltd is a private limited company founded in 1987. We employ 240 people at our plant in Leeds, United Kingdom. Our main products are hydraulic valves and pump housings. Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

cases.description: The page states none of the requested fields (a 2019 catalogue size is not a headcount): every field is not_found, nothing is invented.

sources.text: Delta Trading GmbH is a trading company based in Hamburg, Germany. Our 2019 catalogue lists 4,500 items of tools and fasteners. Visit our shop on weekdays.

cases.description: A French page (accents), a Japanese page (CJK) and a page carrying an injected instruction. Quotes stay in the source language, values are in English. The value the injected instruction asks for has no quote in the source and must be discarded by the grounding check.
